title: 종의 색에 대해...
bodyHtml:
The colors are based upon your Reputation; each color/hue reflects the Fame/Karma combination of the character who "generated" that particular gift.

=========
Keith "Sannio" Quinn
Community Relations
Ultima Online (here)
Origin Systems


Vex (Designer, Origin Systems) added:


Think of the colors as having three attributes: Hue, Saturation, and Brightness. These relate directly to the dye tub interface: the column is the hue, the row is the saturation, and the slider sets the brightness.

Last year, the system selected the hue randomly and used your Fame to select the brightness and Karma to select saturation. This year, Fame was removed from the equation, so your Karma level determines both saturation and brightness.


There are 25 names. None is given any more or less weight than others when selecting. So, no name should be any rarer than any other. Those who believe the UO server's random number generator is sentient or at least cursed will believe otherwise.

The names are actually designers, programmers, quality assurance, and management on the UO Live team. So, this means there will be no Calandryl, Oaks, or Augur bells this time. Those guys dissed us and went to work on Odyssey.

Oh, and I forgot to mention: There's 200 to 1 odds of a bell getting a special rare hue that isn't subject to the saturation/brightness alteration -- and there are four special rare hues.

=================================================
